<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Barrier''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">敵を阻め</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手がキャラクターか宇宙船を配備した直後に使用する。１フォース消費すること。そのキャラクターまたは宇宙船は、このターンの間中、戦闘と移動を行うことができない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-105o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デス・スター内で追跡された末、ルークとレイアは、追ってくるストームトルーパーたちを足止めするため、ブラスト・ドアを閉じた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hold the enemy.

'''Card text:''' Use immediately after the opponent deploys a character or starship. Use 1 Force. That character or starship may not battle or move for the remainder of this turn.

'''Lore:''' After being chased through the Death Star, Luke and Leia closed a blast door to stop the pursuing stormtroopers.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Barrier]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
